input.name: images
input.resize: aspect-preserving centered letterbox to 512x512, padding value 114
input.normalization: divide pixels by 255; no CLAHE or ImageNet normalization

output.name: output0
output.layout: [batch,4+classes,anchors]; channels 0..3 are cx,cy,w,h in letterboxed input pixels; channels 4.. are class scores
output.postprocessing: class-aware NMS, suggested initial confidence .25 and IoU .45; undo letterbox for source coordinates

limitations: experimental, small dataset and limited capture sessions
does not estimate 3D pose or verify full assembly correctness
host runtime compatibility is not an on-tablet performance measurement
